=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: "Add a default-true update_via_pull_request input and implement creation or reuse of ai-sync/stable with merge after verification, retaining direct push only when the input is false." (Linked issue #7128, "Activation gaps after PR #7125", fix item 3.)
  Expected change site: `workflow-templates/ai-update-workflows.yml` — the consumer wrapper's `with:` block (lines 54-55) and its `workflow_dispatch:` block (line 45) need to surface `update_via_pull_request` to consumers.
  Evidence of absence: The reusable workflow `update_workflows.yml` defines the input with `default: true` on both `workflow_call` (line 9-19) and `workflow_dispatch` (line 29-39) and implements the direct-push path when it is `false` (lines 1212-1222), but the consumer template's `with:` block (line 55) passes only `allow_workflow_edits`. The template's `workflow_dispatch: {}` is empty (line 45), so even a manual dispatch cannot override the input. Every consumer repository using this wrapper therefore always takes the default-true PR path and has no supported mechanism to select the documented "direct push only when the input is false" behavior. The editor's previous-run note deferred this as "conflicts with `test_template_inputs_and_secrets_exist_in_workflow_call`", but that test constrains the `@stable`-pinned updater's input surface, which is exactly what this PR advances; the input is now defined, so the test (and the template) can be updated in this same PR to forward the new input. The new `test_consumer_template_gate_and_permissions` test in `tests/test_update_workflows_pull_request_delivery.py` verifies the gate and `allow_workflow_edits` forwarding but does not pin the `update_via_pull_request` forwarding, so the test would not catch a regression in the missing half of the contract.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
